ownershipNote: Lot P6 scaffold: package layout, single JSX source build (Preact dist + React emission by specifier rewrite), compat/runtime/signals adapters and React twins, coverage-manifest hook, port-metrics, package-guard, and React-leg harness. Modules are ported incrementally in groups of batches.

adapters.role: The only module importing preact/compat (createPortal -> react-dom)

Core-only Preact adapter: forwardRef, SVG presentation-attribute and tabIndex normalisation, useInsertionEffect, useSyncExternalStore, textInput, textChange, dblClick, focusWithin, focusOut, type aliases
The only module importing @preact/signals (MaybeSignal, isSignal, useValue, unwrap)

semanticMapping.preact: MaybeSignal<T> = T | ReadonlySignal<T>; components read edge props via useValue() and keep hooks inside
semanticMapping.react: MaybeSignal<T> = T; emitted React props stay type-identical to @sentropic/dataviz-react

semanticMapping.preact: useSyncExternalStore implemented on Preact core in src/runtime.ts (Object.is bailout, layout recheck, SSR getServerSnapshot)

Intrinsic SVG presentation attributes normalised to kebab-case by options.vnode in src/runtime.ts (textAnchor, dominantBaseline, strokeWidth, strokeDasharray, strokeLinecap, strokeLinejoin, fontSize; viewBox, preserveAspectRatio, clipPathUnits and textLength preserved); tabIndex normalised to tabindex on every intrinsic element including SVG
semanticMapping.react: React camelCase SVG props and tabIndex

semanticMapping.preact: Imports design-system primitives and charts from @sentropic/design-system-preact
React spelling className kept; signal-valued className read via useValue/classNames
Local handlers compose with, never overwrite, consumer callbacks
semanticMapping.react: Identical composed handlers on the emitted React leg
